name: Algo Four XL
notes: After the Yamaha DX100 Owner's Manual: 8 voices (1 = mono), 4 operators, algorithm 1..8, op 4 feedback. Per operator: ratio (st) + detune (ct) + octave, level, envelope (r1 AR, r2 D1R to l2 D1L, r3 D2R to l3, r4 RR), velocity, level and rate scaling, AM switch, EG bias. LFO: wave (1 saw up, 2 square, 3 triangle, 4 S&H, 5 sine), speed with range (slow down to 0.0008 Hz, fast up to 80), delay, sync (starts at the peak), PMD, AMD, PMS, AMS.
